title: Test Engineer / Civil Engineer
company: BMW BAVARIA MOTORS - La Garde / Ollioules - Toulon
description:
**Role Description**
The Test Engineer / Civil Engineer role at BMW BAVARIA MOTORS – La Garde / Ollioules – Toulon is a part-time, hybrid position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with flexibility for some work from home. The role involves planning, designing, and executing test activities related to automotive and civil engineering projects, ensuring that systems, components, and infrastructure meet performance and safety standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing detailed test plans and test cases, performing functional testing, documenting test results, and reporting issues to relevant stakeholders. The Test Engineer / Civil Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams, contributes to continuous improvement of testing methodologies, and supports project documentation and compliance with applicable regulations and internal quality guidelines.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Test Engineering and Testing, with the ability to apply structured methods and industry best practices.
* Experience in Test Execution and working with detailed Test Cases to validate system functionality and performance.
* Proficiency in Functional Testing, including identifying defects, documenting findings, and supporting root-cause analysis.
* Educational background in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Knowledge of automotive systems, civil infrastructure, or related engineering domains.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
* Comfort with hybrid work arrangements, including coordination of on-site and remote tasks.
* Familiarity with relevant safety standards, quality management systems, and regulatory requirements is an advantage.
